'''2007 Kashyyyk Regionals Matt Sokol LS Hidden Base''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Matt Sokol]] at [[2007 Kashyyyk Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|SE-L-hiddenbase.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Same Shit 2
* '''Username:''' mr purple
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
